::: {#sol-negate-forall}

"Some test fails": $\exists t \in T, \neg P(t)$.
"Every test passes" is false exactly when at least one test does not pass.

"Every test fails", $\forall t \in T, \neg P(t)$, is not the negation:
when some tests pass and some fail,
both it and "every test passes" are false.

:::
